title: Enchantment Rarity
description: Ever wanted to make your enchantment have a different rarity depending if they're in or above vanilla levels?
body:
# Description:
Enchantment Rarity is a datapack that was made to add this small yet interesting feature.
![Altar SMP Enchantment Rarity Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82a5222fcd85bcf5f31dccc5c684fbacfc1c8bc4_0.webp)
This image was taken from [leekleek's "This Bow Steals Armor" video.](https://youtu.be/FIor038gBBw?si=cgu1Iu8EFN0G__A1)

This pack simply adds this feature and that's it.
